title: Batch Type and the Dropped-Batch Stage Surcharge: A Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts Training Note
content:
On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the stage surcharge on a dropped-batch violation is adjusted by the type of the dropped batch, as the batch record in Cartwise Shopper Batches names it.

**Rule.** On an Express 30 Batch the stage surcharge is doubled. On a Stock-Up Batch it is increased by half of itself, the half rounded up to a whole point. On any other batch type — Shop-Only Batch, Single Delivery Batch, Double Delivery Batch or Triple Delivery Batch — it is used as it stands.

## Questions answered

**What is the adjusted figure on an Express 30 Batch with a stage surcharge of 1 point?** Doubled: 2 points.

**And with 2 points?** Doubled: 4 points.

**On a Stock-Up Batch with a stage surcharge of 1 point?** Half of 1 point is half a point, rounded up to 1 whole point; 1 point increased by 1 point gives 2 points.

**On a Stock-Up Batch with 2 points?** Half of 2 points is 1 point, already whole; 2 points increased by 1 point gives 3 points.

**When there is no stage surcharge?** Doubling nothing, or adding half of nothing, still leaves nothing, whatever the batch type.

**On a Double Delivery Batch with 2 points?** Used as it stands: 2 points.

## At a glance

| Stage surcharge before adjustment | Express 30 Batch | Stock-Up Batch | Any other batch type |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | None | None | None |
| 1 point | 2 points | 2 points | 1 point |
| 2 points | 4 points | 3 points | 2 points |

The half on a Stock-Up Batch is rounded up to a whole point before it is added.
